entrypoint.description: A prompt file path relative to the coworker declaration.

model.description: The concrete Codex model used for this coworker.

reasoning_effort.description: The reasoning effort used with the selected Codex model.

isolated.description: Run the action read-only and offline without exposing CWR host tools. Intended for transforming untrusted input into a validated result.

selective_history.description: Deliver recent shared messages and participant-scoped history browsing for conversational Codex requests by default. Set false in the Codex role's adapters.params to receive full shared history; isolated and named-action requests always use full history.

context_window_tokens.description: Legacy compatibility parameter. Retained when checking compatibility with an existing private Codex conversation; ignored for context budgeting. Codex resolves its model context window and manages token accounting and compaction. Leave this parameter unchanged on existing coworkers and omit it on new coworkers.
